title: Career Roadmap · Auxiliary Nurse Midwife
summary: An Auxiliary Nurse Midwife supports maternal and child healthcare, immunisation, family welfare, basic community health services and health education, particularly in primary and rural healthcare settings.

facts.Current degree: Recognised Auxiliary Nurse Midwifery (ANM) programme and applicable nursing registration

blocks.label: Recommended stream
blocks.text: Science with Biology is useful; confirm the current ANM admission rules for accepted streams.

blocks.label: Important subjects
blocks.text: Biology, English, basic chemistry, health education and human development.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: Eligibility, age limits and selection processes depend on current Indian Nursing Council and state notifications.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Maternal health, newborn care, immunisation, nutrition and community outreach.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Empathy, communication, accurate recordkeeping, hygiene and teamwork.

items.text: ANM diploma → Auxiliary nursing and maternal-child/community health roles, subject to qualification and registration.
GNM diploma → Broader general nursing pathway; distinct from ANM.
B.Sc. Nursing → Degree-level nursing pathway, with separate admission eligibility.
Further study after ANM → Explore recognised progression options; eligibility for GNM or degree programmes is institution- and regulation-dependent.

blocks.label: Eligibility reference
blocks.text: The Indian Nursing Council’s published ANM criteria include 10+2 in specified Arts, Science or Health Care Science vocational streams, English requirements as stated in its criteria, medical fitness, and age conditions. Confirm the latest state notification before applying.
Indian Nursing Council

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Fundamentals of nursing, anatomy, hygiene, nutrition and community health.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: Maternal and newborn care, child health, family welfare, immunisation and supervised clinical/community practice.

blocks.label: Clinical placement
blocks.text: Build competence in patient observation, documentation, health education and referral procedures.

blocks.label: Final stage
blocks.text: Prepare for examinations, registration and recruitment requirements.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Antenatal visit checklist • Immunisation follow-up register • Maternal nutrition education leaflet • Newborn danger-sign awareness session.

blocks.text: Academic records, English proficiency where required, programme prerequisites, clinical placement checks and visa documentation. Professional nursing practice usually requires meeting the destination country’s registration rules.

blocks.label: Typical pathway
Important
blocks.text: An Indian ANM qualification does not automatically confer Registered Nurse or Midwife status abroad. Confirm recognition with the destination country’s regulator before applying.
